scripts.count_output: echo "Number of lines in $npm_package_config_outLREFile $(cat $npm_package_config_outLREFile | wc -l) ($(cat $npm_package_config_outLREFile | wc -c) caracters)"
scripts.build: f() { yarn buildswcplugin && tsx build.ts --output $npm_package_config_outLREFile && node --check $npm_package_config_outLREFile && yarn count_output; }; f
scripts.builddebug: f() { yarn buildswcplugin && tsx build.ts --output $npm_package_config_outLREFile --debug && node --check build/lre.debug.js; }; f
scripts.buildtrace: f() { yarn builddebug && tsx build-trace.ts && node --check build/lre.trace.js; }; f
scripts.buildtest: f() { yarn buildswcplugin && tsx build.ts --input src/test.lre.ts --output $npm_package_config_outLRETestFile --debug && node --check build/lre-test.debug.js; }; f
scripts.buildall: yarn build && yarn builddebug && yarn buildtest
scripts.cleanbuild: f() { shopt -s nullglob; for f in build/*; do rm -rf "$f"; done; }; f
scripts.checkcode: yarn ts-unused-exports tsconfig.json --excludePathsFromReport="src/mock;src/swc" && yarn spell && yarn tscheck && yarn eslint
